gloss: way of eating; eating manner; how to eat

definitions.gloss: way of eating; how to eat; eating manner
definitions.explanation: The manner in which someone eats — whether referring to instructions for a particular food, table manners, or an individual's eating habits. Formed by attaching the suffix {方|かた} ('way of doing') to {食|た}べる.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧。
examples.english: Their way of eating is messy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me how to eat this dish.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧うち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{教|おし}えたい→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: I want to teach my child the proper way to eat with chopsticks from an early age.

notes:
Formed by the productive pattern verb-stem + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ ('way of Xing'). Applies to both manner (table manners) and method (instructions for an unfamiliar food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧・⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: skilled / clumsy at eating
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{綺麗|きれい}・⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧: neat / messy eating manner
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{食|た}べ{方|かた}: the proper way to eat
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: to show how to eat

RELATED PATTERN:
- ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧: how to make
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧: how to read; reading (of a kanji)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: how to use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧: dining etiquette — specifically formal manners
- ⟦{食|く}い→食う：02657_kuu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: rougher/casual variant — masculine, colloquial, can sound coarse
